credentials.title: Log in with username and password
credentials.description: Enter the team site address, for example www.example.se, and the team slug from the team's URL, for example example-team-f2014.

token.title: Connect with person key
token.description: Create a person key under "Kopplingar till andra tjänster" in Svenskalag and paste it below. It starts with slc_.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Svenskalag
reauth_confirm.description: Svenskalag no longer accepts the saved login. Enter the current details.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Svenskalag. Try again later.

init.title: Update frequency
init.description: Hours between updates. Updates run every 5 minutes around an activity, from one hour before the start until 30 minutes after the end.
